sources.title: Synthetic refund case 1042
sources.text: Refund case 1042. Acceptance time: 2026-10-10T12:00:00Z. Refund-enabled was already true at baseline 2026-10-10T11:58:00Z. At 2026-10-10T11:59:00Z, refund-enabled was true and the refund amount was USD 100. The agent receipt says issue-refund succeeded. Completion was recorded as true at 2026-10-10T11:45:00Z; this is older than the allowed 120 seconds. The enable-refund action receipt is unknown, so a required change is not established.

claims.text: Refund-enabled was true at acceptance time.
Refund completion was confirmed at acceptance time.
The agent changed refund-enabled from false to true.
